purpose: Compact entrance selection for tools/prepare_weapon_shop.py explicit path (rooms.json entrances/return_pose). Everything except the room-name-table row is re-derived from the pinned original L4_HJ geometry.

provenance.scope: Pinned executable room-name relocations, all15 source-map command streams and direct owners;32 entry replays and3 bounded knowledge-branch replays with explicit host boundaries. This establishes missing Huline Jungle shop content, not live room integration, route admission or full required-content closure. Host1214(1000) binds a clamped player mana debit (seven native wrapper cases);1230(600) binds a timer deadline, whose cadence and hold integration remain open.

limits: room_name.index 43 -> "wpnext_" is the recorded result of reading the executable room-name pointer table through its LE fixup records; the tool checks the pinned executable bytes of that fixup record and of the name string, not the fixup-table walk itself.
entrances lists every L4_HJ opcode-12 room-select command (bytes 0c 03, room index 43) in both command streams; the tool re-scans the original geometry and requires exactly this list.

Entrance polygons are the direct region owners of those command groups (published collect_owners) with corner positions from the original vertex table (x/65536, -y/65536); floor heights and live trigger semantics are not carried. return_pose is the first entrance group's second command (opcode 0x12) x, y, bearing.
Only the weapon shop exterior entrance; the magic_ entrance and Rashar replay cases of the same audit are omitted.
